notes.title: AvoCuddle V1.06 Update
notes.content:
[h1]New Languages[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34948262/a6def6496c34982227165b120accb0ee3de54553.jpg[/img]
[b]We are excited to announce that AvoCuddle is available in 8 new languages!
[/b]
The new languages are:
[list]
[*]French language thanks to Rappeneau Stéphane and Mohamed-Ali Meftah.
[*]Chinese language thanks to Moupflowers.
[*]Turkish language thanks to AvoLn and Hande Shiri.
[*]Hungarian language thanks to Seweryn Balog.
[*]Greek language thanks to Sakis Mpalatsoukas.
[*]Italian language thanks to Gianmarco Palma.
[*]Spanish language thanks to Rodrigo Nuricumbo.


It's feels great to be able to share our game with new players from all over the  world. A big welcome to everybody who plays AvoCuddle for the first time today, thanks you so much for giving our game demo  a try, we hope you enjoy it.


And again, thanks to people who supported us to reach here specially the great people who helped us in translated the game to the new 7 languages.

Regards,
AvoRa and AvoLn.

[/list]

notes.title: Update version 1.05
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34948262/f62733359f54396dbe7348a9f4e66fb25dde44ba.jpg[/img]
Update version 1.05 change-log:
[list]
[*] Upgraded the engine to support multi-languages.
[*] Added French language thanks for Rappeneau Stéphane and Mohamed-Ali Meftah.
[*] Added Chinese language thanks for Moupflowers
[*]Fixed a bug preventing airflow in level 5 from being activated.
[*]Fixed a bug were player move while showing idle animation or can't run until he jumps.
[*]Linked some SFX with the SFX volume mixer.
[*]Fixed the conversation location with Limona to avoid overlaping with accessing Limon shop in Loneliness planet.


[/list]

notes.title: Localization in progress
notes.content:
Our game engine now supports multi-languages:

we currently localizing the game for Turkish and Chinese languages, and we are looking for volunteers to translate the game to all other languages.
In return we will provide the volunteers with free copies of the game in addition of mentioning their names in the credits.
if you are interested massage me on my e-mail:
ramez_magni(at)hotmail(dot)com


Best regards
Ramez

notes.title: Update version 1.04
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34948262/f62733359f54396dbe7348a9f4e66fb25dde44ba.jpg[/img]
Change-log:
[list]
[*] Adjusted some terrains in AvoPlanet Underground to prevent player from entering inside the terrain.
[*] Player now can't parachute and jet-packing at same time to prevent exploiting that to reach places the player shouldn't reach.
[*] Fixed the shortcut in area 4 in the Passion planet so player go through the area as expected, without ruining the experience of that area.
[*] Linked some SFX with the master mixer to respond to the volume changes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update version 1.03
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34948262/6939513e7728be96444fd9f495b4f4056ff16c02.jpg[/img]
Change-log:
[list]
[*] The player location now can be checked when you open the map.
[*] Shortened the spaceship takeoff cut-scene duration
[*] Changed the mechanic to interact with Limon shop, now you just need to press action button (E) when you reach the shop to avoid the previous confusion of opening inventory.
[*] Changed the attach upgrade  process, now all what you need to do is click on the upgrade then click Attach button.
[*] Fixed the lag when you switch weapons
[*] Detaching weapon now reset the description correctly.
[*] changed the location of some enemies to make sure they don't interrupt the conversations
[/list]

notes.title: Update V1.02
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34948262/f0eb37a23b29c27e892a26edb8e46236e22cb421.png[/img]
Change log:
[list]
[*] Maximum quality is default graphics quality settings.
[*] Adjusted the terrain in Intimacy planet to prevent AvoRa from entering them so he can only use homing missile launcher to destroy obstacles.
[*] Added damage on touch to the moving turrets in Intimacy planet.
[*] Fixed a bug in Passion planet were some torches get auto lit when player restart from last check point.
[*] Reduced the difficulty of Passion Volcano level by reducing the lava move up speed.
[*] Skipping cut-scenes now requires holding Q button for 3 secs.
[/list]

notes.title: Update AvoCuddle V1.01
notes.content:
[list]
[*] added the number of hidden moon stones to each level.
[*] increased the font size of inventory description
[*] added life bar to the pig enemy
[*] Maximum graphics settings have been set as default instead of minimum 
[*] Some items description has been improved
[*] Homing missile launcher speed decreased
[*] Fixed winning mini games in Intimacy planet to show the riddle text appropriately
[*] decreased the chance of the character to go inside terrain
[*] Fixed flame of love in area 5 in Passion level so it respawns if you got hit.
[*] Reduced the difficulty of duck shooting mini-game
[*] Fixed a bug that causes losing control if you lit the torches in AvoPlanet Underground in certain order
[/list]

notes.title: First detailed review by Zeepond
notes.content:
We are happy to share with you the first detailed review of our game by zeepond 
and we so glad that we got score 8/10 :
the review says in short :
"AvoCuddle: An Entertaining Platformer with Imaginative Dynamics that Utilizes the Most Powerful Force in the Known Universe, "Love"!"
 
you can check details on the following link:
https://www.zeepond.com/zeepond-reviews/avocuddle
